plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-13 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Physics Education program page (poid=10902) and its linked official degree map, 'Physics Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'Physics Education (Campus)' (the workbook's Index lists Online as N/A for this program), last updated/reviewed August 3, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Every semester's courses sum to the map's printed semester total (15/14/16/16/16/15/16/12) and the plan to the catalog's printed totals, Total Credits, BA/BS Degree with Licensure: 120 and the map's Total Degree Plan Credits: 120; the map includes the full licensure course set and both totals are 120, so there is no licensure shortfall. Collected as the Bachelor of Science: the map's own note states that students electing to complete the Bachelor of Arts will take 16 credits of one foreign language, which are not included in this plan. Per the catalog, all courses must be passed with a C (2.0) or better to be counted in the major, all prerequisite courses must be passed with C (2.0) or better, and credits greater than 10 years old will not be accepted for this degree. The catalog Physics Education Curriculum (46 credits) is exercised exactly: Core Requirements 24, Physics Electives 9 exercised by the map's three 3-credit elective rows carrying the catalog's five-course list (the map labels the first row 'Major Physics Elective' and the later two 'Major Physics Upper-division Elective'; all three carry the same catalog list as printed), and Teacher Education Courses 13 (PSCI 4870, PSCI 4900, PHYS 4980). The Professional Education Requirements for Secondary Licensure are placed in full: the Pre-Admission Courses (EDUC 2100, EDUC 2200, EDUC 2400, SPED 2010, SCED 3180, SCED 3720, with the catalog's generic 'Academic 3900/4900 - Methods Course(s)' slot exercised through the major's PSCI 4870 and PSCI 4900, which the catalog footnote counts only once in the degree total), the Block Courses (SCED 3570, SCED 3590), and the Advanced Teacher Education Program Courses (EDUC 4930 and student teaching, the catalog's generic 'Academic 4980 - Student Teaching' exercised through PHYS 4980). SCED 3180 is catalogued at 2-3 credits and recorded at the map's 2. The catalog's degree-type requirement (12 credits for the BS, 16 for the BA) notes that a portion of the BS requirement may be met by fulfilling the General Education Core and Breadth Areas, so the catalog blocks do not sum arithmetically to 120. Catalog titles are recorded where the map abbreviates them (PHYS 2210, EDUC 2400, SCED 3590). Map free-elective rows total 19 credits and free upper-division rows 8, recorded as printed.
